svg.title: Insertional and reciprocal translocations
svg.desc: Both rows start with ABCDEFGH in blue and JKLMNO in green. In the top row, EF moves into the other chromosome, yielding ABCDGH and JKLEFMNO. In the bottom row, GH and NO exchange places, yielding ABCDEFNO and JKLMGH. White zigzags mark new joins. Each chromosome retains its centromere.
